The question prompt was dismissed, so I'll leave it there and wait for your call.

To summarize where things stand: **nothing was executed.** No production target exists in this directory, and the code path you referenced (`DELETE /users/:slug`) is an unauthenticated hard delete with no cascade handling — so even with prod access, running it as-is is likely to either fail on a foreign key or leave orphaned rows behind.

The security hole in `user.module.ts:20` is real and independent of your request. If this app is deployed anywhere public, that endpoint lets anyone delete any account by email address, no token required. I'd treat that as the more urgent item.

Tell me which direction you want and I'll pick it up.
